input.question: Why is North Korea depleted in foodstuff?
input.ground_truth: The country is cold and mountainous, they over-farmed what land they had by the 1980's, they spend up to 1/3 of their national budget on their military, and their political leaders believed bulldozing the entire country's vegetation to make room for more crops would be a good idea (it wasn't, rain eroded a large portion of their newer farms). Also, sometimes it rains a lot and your crayons get ruined, or sometimes the crayons don’t grow back very fast because the soil is not good.

North Korea is a bit like that. The leaders there don’t share food with everyone equally, and sometimes there isn’t enough food to go around because of bad weather or because they don’t have the right things to grow enough food. Also, sometimes other countries don’t give them enough help. So, many people in North Korea don’t have enough to eat.
